rent.note: Furnished 1+1 in Konyaaltı or Lara (Güzeloba/Şirinyalı). Live emlakjet asking rents of 28,000–45,000 TL, median about 35,000 TL (about $712 at 49.13 TRY/USD), plus a small premium for 1–3 month terms. Several winter lets end on 1 June.

utilities.note: Electric, water and home internet. Wise gives £67 utilities plus £10 internet for an 85 m² flat (about $102 at 0.756 GBP/USD), scaled down for a 55–65 m² 1+1. Summer air-con pushes bills up.

groceries.note: Home cooking. Wise gives £160/month per person (about $212); Migros/BİM plus weekly pazars.

diningOut.note: Derived: about 14 meals out at about $9 (Wise: inexpensive meal £6) plus about 15 café coffees at about $3.50.

transit.note: Official full fare is 42 TL per boarding with Antalyakart, transfers free; there is no general monthly pass. 40 boardings is about 1,680 TL ($34), plus the odd taxi.

coworking.note: Thin coworking scene, and no operator price page could be verified. Aggregator figures range from $80–200 (guide listing, possibly AI-written) to $248 (nomads.com, formulaic). Set near Istanbul's $120.

simData.note: Turkcell Tourist Welcome Pack: 20 GB plus 200 minutes for 30 days, about 1,800 TRY in mid-2026. Foreign phones are IMEI-blocked after 120 days, which doesn't affect 1–3 month stays.

misc.note: Gym, hammam, toiletries, museum and site entries, buffer. Set between Istanbul ($120) and Chania ($145) less Turkey's lower price level.

accomSeasonality._doc: Editorial. Annual-lease owners switch flats to holiday lets for Jun–Sep (several emlakjet winter lets end 1 June), so monthly rents for short stays rise sharply in summer and are cheapest Dec–Feb.
